plan: Keep one authoritative session dict with exactly the four contract keys; mutate it in place only after an action fully validates, so error paths can never corrupt accepted data.

Centralize presentation in a _screen(prompt, messages) builder that returns a fresh {prompt, messages, choices} dict and derives choices solely from the prompt (appointment copies when prompt == 'Choose appointment', else empty), guaranteeing determinism and the choices invariant.

Implement handle as a dispatch table over the six action types; each handler validates preconditions and payload types (strict isinstance checks, str check before set membership to avoid unhashable-value exceptions) and returns either the accepted screen or an 'Error: ...' screen built from unchanged state.

Compute post-action prompts from state via _next_prompt (unmet-step order: Confirm contact -> Choose appointment -> Review and complete), reused by contact confirmation and correction; fixed prompts for complete ('Check-in complete', ['Checked in']) and abandon ('Session abandoned', ['Check-in abandoned']).

Expose replaceable ports as plain duck-typed attributes action_source/screen_sink; run_once raises RuntimeError before calling either when one is missing, otherwise read_action -> handle -> display exactly once -> return the same screen object.
Copy the appointments sequence (per-entry dict copies) at construction and precompute the known-id set for O(1) validation.
mechanisms: authoritative session dict mutated only after validation (validate-then-commit)
single deterministic screen-builder with prompt-derived choices
dispatch-table action interpreter with strict payload validation
duck-typed injectable input/output ports with precondition RuntimeError
defensive copying of constructor input and emitted choices
